# Pacific North Systems
> Custom software and automation for teams with complex operations in Metro Vancouver.

## About
Pacific North Systems builds custom business software, workflow automation, dashboards, field tools, and AI powered systems for Canadian small and midsize businesses. We focus on replacing manual data entry, connecting disconnected tools, and building software that fits how teams actually work.
